request: Let readers save articles to read later — a "Saved" page listing what they saved, and a save/unsave control that can go on an article. Store each save as a SavedArticle record with userId and articleId (the Contentful id, same as we do for ratings) — I do not want a second way of identifying an article appearing later, so make sure that decision is written down where the next person will find it.

operations.intent: Logic component that reads/writes SavedArticle records keyed by userId and articleId (Contentful id, same identifier used for ratings). Inputs: Do, articleId; outputs: Success, Failure, isSaved — toggles save/unsave state and reports current saved status.
Small toggle control (in: articleId, isSaved; out: Click) showing a saved/not-saved icon state, meant to be dropped onto the Article component and wired to Logic Components/Save Article Toggle.

New page listing the current user's saved articles by querying SavedArticle records for the logged-in userId, then resolving each articleId via Get Article From Slug/Contentful GraphQL to render article summaries linking to /Pages/Article.
Add an instance of the new Save Button component (passing articleId) wired to Logic Components/Save Article Toggle so readers can save/unsave the article they are viewing.
Add a route/navigation entry to Pages/Saved (e.g. a 'Saved' link in the main nav, gated by Logic Components/Is user logged in?) so readers can reach their saved articles list.

Document the new SavedArticle record shape (userId + articleId using the Contentful id, the same identifier already used for ratings) and the new /Pages/Saved route, explicitly noting articleId is the single canonical article identifier to prevent a second identification scheme from emerging.
